coupling: The earlier commit prefetches the first ISO byte into byte 48 of the Nikon camera software buffer, then clears that byte before converting the software field to a string. The later commit removes the clear because, with the original 48-byte read, byte 48 in its 49-byte buffer is zero-initialized. Together the 49-byte prefetch fills the entire 49-byte buffer and the conversion uses a C string with no terminator, reading beyond the allocation. Either edit alone leaves a terminator; repairing the path requires reconciling the prefetch with the buffer size and string boundary across both commits.
